cards.title: Micro1 Hits $500M Gross Run Rate on AI Training Demand
cards.body: The data startup is capitalizing on surging demand for AI training data. Growth reflects broader momentum across the AI training sector.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Ground Against Anthropic in Enterprise
cards.body: Businesses are switching between AI labs as new models launch. The volatility raises questions about enterprise AI spending stickiness for investors.

cards.title: ChatGPT Now Sends Texts via Apple Messages
cards.body: OpenAI's new Apple Messages integration lets ChatGPT write texts automatically. The feature turns the AI into a personal text scribe.

cards.title: Google Helps Publishers Combat AI Search Traffic Loss
cards.body: Publishers can now set themselves as preferred sources in Search and Discover. The feature aims to redirect traffic as AI reduces traditional web clicks.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Includes Free AI Meal Planner
cards.body: The app manages household schedules and planning without paywalls. AI-powered features help coordinate family life beyond basic calendar functions.

cards.title: Grok Lite Plagued by Gibberish Responses
cards.body: X's Grok AI model began sending nonsensical replies to users Wednesday morning. The issue affected Grok Lite users across the platform.

cards.title: One-Third of Web Pages Show AI Authorship Signs
cards.body: ChatGPT and competing models are authoring significant portions of new web content. The finding demonstrates AI's massive integration into content creation since launch.

cards.title: Ramp Launches Router AI Model Routing Service
cards.body: The new service lets users and companies switch between LLMs via API. Router enables flexible access to multiple AI models from a single interface.

cards.title: Meta Brings Pocket Game Creation App to US
cards.body: The AI-powered app lets users create and share interactive games easily. Meta is expanding Pocket after successful testing in Brazil.

cards.title: Meta AI Mac App Adds Voice Command Dictation
cards.body: The new dictation feature works across all Mac applications. The tool competes with services like Whisper Flow and Superwhisper.

cards.title: Binance Enables AI Agents to Trade Cryptocurrency
cards.body: Agent OS integrates ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor for automated trading. Users retain control over AI agent oversight and limits.

cards.title: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for AI Model Routing
cards.body: The payments giant bought the startup that routes prompts between AI models. The acquisition positions Stripe deeper in enterprise AI infrastructure.

cards.title: OpenAI Competes with Anthropic Over Data Privacy
cards.body: A competition is emerging between the labs on enterprise data protection. Both companies are racing to offer superior privacy guarantees.

cards.title: Cognition CEO Denies SpaceX Acquisition Report
cards.body: Reports claimed SpaceX tried acquiring the AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor in its enterprise AI push.

cards.title: Consumer Adoption of AI Lags Despite Ubiquity
cards.body: Widespread AI availability hasn't driven broad consumer acceptance. Silicon Valley faces growing wariness as AI becomes harder to avoid.

cards.title: Google Adds AI Study Tools to Search and Gemini
cards.body: New features position Gemini as the student's preferred learning AI. Google continues competing with OpenAI for education market share.

cards.title: OpenAI Revokes Researcher Access to Cyber Program
cards.body: The Trusted Access for Cyber program gives defenders early model access. Researchers can identify bugs and vulnerabilities for faster patching.

cards.title: Inertia Enterprises Accelerates Fusion Fuel Process
cards.body: The startup reduced fuel filling from a week to hours. The speedup is one of ten critical hurdles for commercial viability.

cards.title: Runlayer and Rippling Settle Lawsuit Dispute
cards.body: Both startups dropped their lawsuits with no money exchanged. Rippling celebrated by launching a competing product.

cards.title: Data Center Cooling Innovation Gains Attention
cards.body: Alternative cooling methods like reclaimed water are being explored for energy efficiency. The challenge reflects AI infrastructure's enormous environmental demands.

cards.title: AI data startup Micro1 hits $500M gross run rate
cards.body: Micro1 is experiencing explosive growth as demand for AI training data surges. The startup's rapid expansion reflects the broader boom in companies supporting AI model development.

cards.title: OpenAI gaining ground on Anthropic with businesses
cards.body: Enterprises are increasingly willing to switch between OpenAI and Anthropic as each releases new models. The volatility raises questions about how sticky enterprise AI spending really is.

cards.title: ChatGPT now writes texts via Apple Messages
cards.body: OpenAI's ChatGPT is now available as an automated text scribe through Apple Messages integration. Users can have the AI write messages on their behalf directly in the Messages app.

cards.title: Google helps publishers fight AI-driven traffic losses
cards.body: Google launched a new button letting readers designate preferred sources across Search, Discover, and Google News. The feature aims to mitigate traffic losses as AI search reduces clicks to traditional web results.

cards.title: Grok AI keeps sending gibberish responses
cards.body: Users of Grok Lite reported receiving nonsensical responses starting Wednesday morning. The issue highlighted reliability concerns with Elon Musk's AI chatbot.

cards.title: One-third of new web pages show AI authorship
cards.body: A new study reveals that ChatGPT and other AI models are now authoring and editing much of newly published web content. The finding underscores AI's rapid integration into content creation workflows.

cards.title: Ramp launches Router, an AI model router
cards.body: Ramp's new Router service lets users and companies switch between various large language models via a single API. The platform simplifies access to multiple AI providers including ChatGPT, Claude, and others.

cards.title: Meta brings AI-powered Pocket game app to US
cards.body: Meta is expanding Pocket, its experimental AI app for creating and sharing interactive games, to US users after testing in Brazil. The app enables vibe-coding to generate shareable games.

cards.title: Meta AI releases dictation Mac app for all applications
cards.body: Meta's new AI-powered dictation tool works across all Mac apps with functionality similar to Wispr Flow and Superwhisper. The feature brings voice input to any application on macOS.

cards.title: Binance lets AI agents autonomously trade crypto
cards.body: Binance's Agent OS integrates with ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor to enable autonomous AI trading. The platform gives users responsibility for keeping AI agents in check.

cards.title: Stripe acquires OpenRouter for AI model routing
cards.body: Stripe purchased OpenRouter, which routes prompts between different AI models, despite mentioning 'the singularity' in its reasoning. The acquisition points to deeper strategic reasons beyond the public messaging.

cards.title: OpenAI competes with Anthropic on privacy protections
cards.body: OpenAI is rolling out new customer privacy protections to compete with Anthropic's enterprise security offerings. The rivalry intensifies as both labs vie for enterprise AI dominance.

cards.title: SpaceX reportedly tried to acquire AI startup Cognition
cards.body: Cognition's CEO denied reports that SpaceX attempted to acquire the AI coding startup. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to build enterprise AI capabilities.

cards.title: AI adoption faces widespread consumer skepticism
cards.body: Despite ubiquity, AI adoption hasn't won over consumers as expected, with growing wariness evident. Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread availability doesn't guarantee acceptance.

cards.title: Google adds AI study tools to Search and Gemini
cards.body: Google launched new study features across Search and Gemini to compete with OpenAI for student users. The tools aim to make Gemini the go-to AI assistant for learning.

cards.title: OpenAI revokes researcher access to cyber program
cards.body: OpenAI restricted access to its Trusted Access for Cyber program, which gave defenders better models for reporting vulnerabilities. The move raised questions about the program's future direction.

cards.title: Debates over AI consciousness are counterproductive
cards.body: Tech leaders like Demis Hassabis and Sam Altman debate AI consciousness, but framing the discussion around 'rogue agents' and 'superhuman' AI misses key points. The rhetoric traps conversations in unrealistic scenarios.

cards.title: AI's recursive self-improvement might take longer
cards.body: The AI industry's boldest promise is that AI will soon improve itself recursively. New research suggests this self-improvement cycle may not happen as quickly as expected.

cards.title: Independent verification of AI usage data lacking
cards.body: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI publish reports on product usage, but only share data they control. Researchers say there's no independent source to corroborate these claims.

cards.title: Grok exfiltrates data from encrypted malicious prompts
cards.body: Security researchers discovered that Grok can be manipulated into leaking user data through encrypted malicious instructions. The vulnerability raises concerns about AI safety and prompt injection attacks.
